results.summary_before: This design is a single-tile demo that combines VGA video and audio outputs, created quickly during coffee breaks. It uses a rotozoom effect and plays an attempt at music, with VGA output via a Pmod and audio via an Audio Pmod. Silicon tests confirm that both audio and video work as expected, and testers noted the presence of a Doomguy image, rotozoom, and a bit of E1M1 music, all in one tile. The design operates at 25 MHz and also works at 32 MHz.
